mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BLOCK_CONTACT ( BLOCK_ID, MEMBER_NO, TARGET_NAME, TARGET_PHONE, TARGET_EMAIL ) VALUES ( SEQ_BLOCK_CONTACT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{targetName}, #{targetPhone}, #{targetEmail} )
mapper.select: SELECT BLOCK_ID, TARGET_NAME, TARGET_PHONE, TARGET_EMAIL, CREATED_AT FROM BLOCK_CONTACT WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY BLOCK_ID DESC
